---
title: "Land Ownership Rules for Foreign Buyers on Isla Verde"
description: "Which land titles a foreign buyer can hold on Isla Verde, how the coastal strip is regulated and what a long lease gives you instead of a freehold."
pubDate: 2026-03-01
author: Isla Verde Editorial
---

**Quick answer:** foreigners may own condominium units outright, while land in the 50 metre coastal strip is held on a 30 year renewable lease.

## The coastal strip

The first 50 metres from the high tide line belong to the state and cannot be sold to anyone, and the next 150 metres may be leased for 30 years with a renewal right.

## What changed in 2026

The average price in Playa Norte in 2026 was 2,400 CRC per sqm, up 4% on the year, according to the registry.

## Registration

Every lease longer than three years must be registered at the land registry within 30 days of signing, or the lease cannot be enforced against a new owner of the land.
